title: A dilute atomic Fermi system with a large positive scattering length
abstract: We show that a dilute atomic Fermi system at sufficiently low temperatures, can display fermionic superfluidity, even in the case of a repulsive atom-atom interaction, when the scattering length is positive. The attraction leading to the formation of Cooper pairs is provided by the exchange of Bogoliubov phonons if a fraction of the atoms form a BEC of weakly bound molecules.
